models.notes: Deterministic rolling-baseline detector for laptop MVP.
Rule/signature RCA until trained ML benchmark is added.
Unified safety score combining AML, drift, xApp, SLA, timing, spectrum, ZSM, and DTN evidence.
Dependency-free online Gaussian baseline and RCA centroid learner. Saves per-run artifacts as self_learning_model.json and can be replay-trained from CSV telemetry.
Trained on imported Open RAN KPM rows. Strong for Open RAN KPM replay; weak transfer to broader five-service virtual scenarios.
Trained on generalized virtual city/industry scenarios covering eMBB, mMTC, URLLC, FWA, and V2X with area, weather, event, time-of-day, mobility, density, interference, and edge-pressure factors.

Adds O-DU/High-PHY/MAC features: CQI, HARQ retransmission, RLC buffer, MAC scheduler delay, beam quality, timing offset, and fronthaul delay. Improves held-out RCA quality on virtual scenarios, but still requires real OAI/FlexRIC or lab PHY telemetry for production proof.

Adds O-RU/Low-PHY RF features: RSRP, RSRQ, RSSI, noise floor, EVM, interference power, beam misalignment, antenna VSWR, and RF temperature. It improves spectrum-interference recall but increases false positives under unseen heavy-rain conditions, so it remains a shadow candidate until calibrated with real RF/lab telemetry.

Adds O-CU features: RRC setup failures, RRC re-establishment, PDCP discard/reordering, SDAP QoS-flow drop, QFI violations, session drops, and mobility ping-pong. It improves QoS/session and mobility recall but increases false positives under held-out event conditions, so it remains a shadow candidate.

Adds Near-RT RIC/xApp arbitration evidence: teacher xApp scoring, direct/multi-xApp conflict detection, control-loop latency estimates, per-control cooldown budgets, QoS xApp weighting, and repeated-control suppression before RIC payload approval.
Adds SMO/Non-RT RIC governance evidence: policy intent, model lifecycle action, active/candidate/rollback model mapping, retraining dataset action, approval gates, governance state, and audit class.

Adds 5G Core and transport impact evidence: AMF registration failures, AMF paging delay, PDU session setup/failure, UPF CPU, UPF packet drop, GTP tunnel loss, N3 RTT, N6 RTT, and transport jitter. It maps core/user-plane symptoms to RCA, healing recommendations, A1 policy payloads, slice impact, xApp arbitration, and SMO/ZSM policy domains.

Adds strict local ML model comparison, group holdout split reporting, confusion matrices, false-positive/false-negative rates, Isolation Forest, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, SQLite feature-row persistence, data-quality event storage, and live OAI metric streaming into the decision engine.
Adds WSL OAI/FlexRIC log pull, expanded OAI metric parsing, live telemetry API status, dashboard live-loop status panel, and live run report generation from JSONL plus SQLite records.
